methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College partners with Google for free AI training - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Free Google AI training at Roanoke College signals potential for distributed capability development in a non-metro region, testing whether institutional partnerships can decommoditize AI literacy beyond the urban core.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Grassroots free AI workshops led by a Norfolk native directly target the technology gap through peer-to-peer knowledge transfer, representing distributed capacity-building outside traditional institutional channels.

signals.title: Virginia Tech sets course for human-centered AI leadership - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's human-centered AI leadership initiative concentrates deep expertise in a research institution, potentially widening the gap between academic hubs and communities lacking access to such specialized knowledge infrastructure.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents deep capability development in a smaller market, testing whether non-metro institutions can build sustained AI fluency rather than shallow platform adoption.

signals.title: Column: AI is reshaping Hampton Roads before our eyes - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: Commentary on AI reshaping Hampton Roads suggests rapid but potentially shallow platform-driven transformation in a defense-tech region, where adoption may outpace local capability to customize or control the technology.
